title: Inquiry into Death of SCDF NSF Firefighter in December 2022
what_it_is: Inquiry into Death of SCDF NSF Firefighter in December 2022

sections.label: Police, Coroner, Board of Inquiry
sections.summary: Police will inform the Coroner of findings, and a Board of Inquiry will be held after the Coroner's findings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When investigations are completed, the Police will inform the Coroner of their findings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Coroner will consider the Police’s investigations and make a finding on the circumstances relating to SGT1 Go’s demise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have decided that we will also convene a Board of Inquiry (BOI) under the Civil Defence Act to conduct a review of the incident.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Since the BOI is also a fact-finding body, it will be held after the Coroner’s findings are established.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The BOI will submit its report to the Minister for Home Affairs (MHA) and we will share the Board’s findings and recommendations at an appropriate juncture.

sections.label: Public release of findings
sections.summary: The findings will be revealed to the public and made public information once completed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Yes, there will be, as I shared in my answer.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: It will be revealed to the public and it will be public information.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At a certain juncture, once we have completed, we will inform the public.
